subject: Focus Lens: mid-cycle OKR snapshot + action items
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Focus Lens: mid-cycle OKR snapshot + action items

Team — attaching the mid-cycle heatmap and a short runway action doc. Quick summary up front:

- Overall progress: green for Serving Runtime perf targets; yellow for SDK adoption; red for QBR-targeted ARR motion in EMEA (BrightPath).
- Main risks: (1) infra throttles for long-sequence evals in Dedicated (Karthik), (2) CS readiness for BrightPath POC (Jonas/Marissa), (3) compliance evidence for procurement (Naomi).

Asks (please call out capacity or timeline if you can't meet):
1) Karthik — can you re-prioritize the kernel-selection rollout to include long-sequence KV cache optimizations? Need ETA for beta by 09/10 so we can validate BrightPath POC. See tab "Infra asks" in QBR_heatmap_v2.xlsx.
2) Marissa — own the BrightPath demo and provide a tight plan (30-min walk-through + perf numbers) by 08/31. Put the demo script in demo_plan_marissa.pdf.
3) Jonas — CS to prepare a 3-step onboarding checklist and own BrightPath communications; schedule triage w/ procurement if needed.
4) Naomi — procurement & security blocker: BrightPath flagged requirements around log retention and audit export. Can you confirm whether current audit logs meet their needs or if we need a scoped exception?

I'll run a 30-minute sync if items drift. Please reply inline with commitments and blockers.

Attachments: QBR_heatmap_v2.xlsx; runway_action_items.docx

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Focus Lens: mid-cycle OKR snapshot + action items

Thanks Vanessa — I'm on the demo. Quick clarifying Qs:
- Do we need synthetic long-sequence perf (1000+ tokens) or the BrightPath sample (avg 450 tokens)? BrightPath said they care about peak tail latency.
- I'll drop a 15-slide deck + perf appendix by Monday (08/31) morning. Attaching the current demo plan for feedback.

Attachment: demo_plan_marissa.pdf

Vanessa / team — noted. Quick tech reality check:
- The kernel-selection changes require a short maintenance window and two validation passes. ETA: feature branch ready 09/03, rollout to Dedicated staging 09/08, internal perf sign-off 09/10 (matches your ask if we prioritize).
- Long-sequence tail latency improvements will consume additional vGPU hours; we can contain cost by enabling conditional batching on the BrightPath route only. Need decision from Product on whether to trade cost for tail latency for this account.
- Can Marissa share the expected token distribution (synthetic vs real) so we can size the caching parameters?

If product OKs prioritization, I'll allocate an extra engineer to accelerate.

Thanks all for the quick turn. Consolidating commitments and immediate next steps:
- Karthik: prioritize kernel-selection branch; target internal perf sign-off by 09/10. If budget trade for tail latency is needed, I'll escalate to Product SLT today.
- Marissa: deck + script due 08/31 AM; include token-distribution appendix and perf draws.
- Jonas: onboarding checklist by 08/27 EOD and run triage with procurement on 08/28.
- Naomi: confirm SOC artifact status by 08/27 EOD; if Legal needed, I'll loop in Chris and Kate.

I'll update the QBR heatmap with these commitments and circulate the final deck by 09/02 for leadership review. If anyone's scope slips, flag me immediately so we can re-scope for the QBR narrative (we need BrightPath as a case study).

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
